summary: Aegon Ltd filed a Form 6-K press release announcing a EUR 150 million increase to its H2 2026 share buyback program, raising the total to EUR 350 million from EUR 200 million. The increase supports its goal of reducing Cash Capital at Holding to around EUR 1.0 billion by year-end 2026. Largest shareholder Vereniging Aegon, holding ~18.4% of voting rights, will participate pro-rata, contributing EUR 26 million for the increment and EUR 63 million overall. Shares are repurchased at daily VWAP on Euronext Amsterdam via a third-party broker, with cancellation planned. Completion targeted for December 23, 2026, under EU MAR. What to watch: pace of repurchases and capital reduction trajectory.
